description: Use this when someone asks for their Vedic birth chart, kundli, janam kundali, sidereal chart, or where their planets are in Vedic astrology (signs, houses, nakshatras, rising sign). Returns all nine planets with sign, degree, house (needs birth time), nakshatra and pada, and each one’s navamsa (D9) sign. If the person asks for only one thing (rising sign, Moon sign, dasha, Manglik), use the narrower tool. Needs birth date and town, and the time for houses; ask if missing. Do not use for Western/tropical charts or daily horoscopes.

birth_place.description: Town or city of birth, with region or country if known, e.g. "Chicago, Illinois, US" or "Pune, India".

birth_time.description: Local clock time of birth, 24-hour HH:MM, e.g. 13:35. As exact as possible (from a birth certificate).

name: vedic_birth_chart
